name: Sóc Sơn
registryBasis: The official Sóc Sơn commune portal has a land-management section with public land-registration/certificate notices, and Hanoi's official cadastral viewer identifies itself as a parcel lookup and positioning service. The viewer was not usable for anonymous parcel extraction in this attempt.

queries.query: Sóc Sơn Hanoi official cadastral map parcel land information portal
queries.result: Found the official Hanoi cadastral viewer (Thửa Đất Số) and the official Sóc Sơn commune land-management page. The viewer landing page loads but requires login; no public parcel feature endpoint or safe geometry was exposed by bounded inspection.

queries.query: Sóc Sơn bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: Official Vietnamese results confirmed the Sóc Sơn commune land-management page and Hanoi's official Thửa Đất Số parcel lookup service. Results did not expose a safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response for Sóc Sơn.

officialLeads.operator: Ủy ban nhân dân xã Sóc Sơn, Hà Nội
officialLeads.observation: Search-indexed official page lists land-registration/certificate inspection notices with cadastral sheet, parcel, and area references. Direct GET timed out during this attempt; no parcel API was exposed.

officialLeads.operator: Hanoi cadastral/land-registration viewer (Thửa Đất Số; Tecotec-hosted interface)
officialLeads.observation: Anonymous GET returned HTTP 200 and a viewer landing page labelled 'Tra cứu và định vị thửa đất' (look up and locate parcels), but the only action was a login link at /auth/login. No public map configuration, service URL, schema, CRS, or parcel response was available from the landing page.

officialLeads.scope: General Hanoi land-use planning, not verified cadastral parcel coverage
officialLeads.observation: Ordinary HTTPS GET failed certificate verification locally; no certificate exception was authorized or attempted. This route is not treated as evidence of absence.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: HTTP 200; official viewer landing HTML retrieved anonymously. It presented a login wall and no public parcel/API configuration.
Not requested: the anonymous landing page exposed login as the only map action. No credentials, private token, or login attempt was used.
Timed out after approximately 20 seconds in the ordinary HTTPS client; search-indexed official content was recorded, but no retry bypass or alternate transport was used.
TLS certificate verification failed in the ordinary client. No narrow certificate exception was authorized or used.

schemaAndCrs.inspection: No anonymous first-party response containing a stable native parcel identity plus geometry was obtained. No source-specific fields were retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Local Sóc Sơn land-management notices and Hanoi cadastral viewer discovery only.
coverageAssessment.exactPointResult: No exact-point parcel query was executed because no safe anonymous parcel endpoint was exposed; this is not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The official Hanoi cadastral viewer may expose parcel data after authentication or through a route not present in its public landing page. The official Sóc Sơn land-management page confirms local administrative land activity but did not yield a public parcel API in this attempt.
